records.name: CDAC
records.statutory_basis: Autonomous scientific society under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India; offers C-DAC postgraduate diploma training
records.evidence: C-DAC's official About page identifies it as an autonomous R&D organisation under MeitY. The institute's official education/admissions material documents postgraduate diploma programmes, so it belongs in the skill/diploma group and admits students.
records.notes: Classified as G9 because this record represents C-DAC's student-facing postgraduate diploma/training route, not a degree university. Family row is not present.

records.name: LBSNAA Mussoorie (Training Academy)
records.statutory_basis: Attached office of the Department of Personnel & Training, Government of India; post-selection civil-services training academy
records.evidence: The official LBSNAA page says the academy is an attached office of DoPT and conducts foundation, professional and in-service training for civil-service entrants and officers. Entry follows UPSC/service selection; it is not an open admissions college.
records.notes: X is intentional: this is a post-selection employer/service academy, not a student-admitting higher-education institute.
